description: Debt recovery dispute between friends turned lender and borrower
party_a_statement: I lent my friend 200000 INR in March 2024 when he said he was in financial trouble. He promised to return it within 6 months. It has now been over 18 months and he has not returned a single rupee despite multiple reminders on WhatsApp. I have the bank transfer records showing I sent him the money. He has now stopped responding to my messages. I want my money back with interest.
party_b_statement: The 200000 INR was not a loan. It was an investment in a business idea we were going to start together. When the business did not move forward we mutually agreed to treat it as a loss. There was never any written loan agreement. I never agreed to return it. We had a falling out personally and now he is claiming it was a loan to harass me. I do not owe him anything.
